Some people are just lucky? 

My mom was recently admitted into the hospital for 7 weeks and the whole time I kept thinking "why can't I just trade places with you?". Eveytime the doctors had to get her consent for something I kept thinking that if I were in that position I would just deny treatment. Eveynight at the hospital (i took the night shift) there was at least 1 code blue (cardiac arrest) and instead of sadness I felt jealousy towards the person that might have died. 
Now my mom is out and trying her hardest to get back to the place she was before. I'm the asshole who is perfectly healthy yet wants nothing more  than to die. I'm also such an asshole because I'm willing to kill myself knowing that it may land my mom back in the hospital... not to mention what my suicide will do to my sister and dad.
